description.description: List the client workspaces on this account, with the id each other tool needs and whether the client's brand profile is ready for a May run. Requires an X-Mako-Key header.

When the brand profile names a competitor May has not researched yet, it reads that competitor's website and Meta ads first, and the run

description.name: get_status
description.description: Check one report order or one May run by its id, or omit the id to list the most recent of both. Returns the status and, once finished, the deliverable id to pass to get_download_url. Requires an X-Mako-Key header.

description.name: list_deliverables
description.description: List everything finished and ready to download on this account: competitor report bundles and May run artifacts. Requires an X-Mako-Key header.

description.name: get_download_url
description.description: Mint a download link for one deliverable. The link works for 10 minutes and then expires, so fetch it when the human is ready to use it rather than in advance. Requires an X-Mako-Key header.

description.name: create_client
description.description: Add a client workspace to the account. Each workspace holds one brand's profile, runs, creatives and campaigns. Plans include a fixed number of active clients, so this fails when the roster is full. Needs the May plan and an X-Mako-Key header.

description.name: draft_brand_from_website
description.description: Read a client's website and fill in most of their brand profile automatically. Takes up to a minute or two. description.name: get_brand_profile
description.description: Read one client's brand profile: what they sell, who buys it, voice, colors, and the campaign defaults. Also reports whether it is confirmed and, if not, exactly which answers are still missing before May can run. Requires an X-Mako-Key header.

description.name: set_brand_profile
description.description: Write or update one client's brand profile. Every field is optional and only what you pass is changed, so this is safe to call repeatedly to correct a website draft. description.name: list_creatives
description.description: List the ad concepts from a May run: headline, primary text, call to action, compliance status, and a download link for each image. Returns the newest version of each concept. Use the variant_id values with build_paused_campaign. Requires an X-Mako-Key header.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_download_url, draft_brand_from_website · Public sink: create_order · Destructive: list_clients, run_may, get_status, list_deliverables, draft_brand_from_website, get_brand_profile, list_creatives.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_download_url, draft_brand_from_website · Public sink: create_order · Destructive: list_clients, run_may, get_status, list_deliverables, draft_brand_from_website, get_brand_profile, list_creatives

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
